identifier.description: The persistent handle that distinguishes this party from another within a scope. Key material, DID, UUID, account name or pseudonym are all admissible carriers — BearerToken and Role both reference an Identity without key material, so the carrier is a descendant concern.

mechanism: The unique distinguishing context of an agent, including its history, reputation, and public keys. Distinguishes 'Self' from 'Other'. Unlike {{nature}} (what you are) or Role (what you do), Identity is the persistent handle that tracks an entity across interactions.
